subtitle._comment_model_size: tiny/base/small = faster, less accurate. medium = balanced (default). large-v3 = most accurate, heaviest on CPU.
subtitle._comment_language: language = SOURCE audio language of the video (used as a hint, default 'id'). output_language = language of the resulting subtitle text: 'id' (transcript as-is) or 'en' (translated by Whisper to English, no AI_API_KEY needed).

style._comment: primary_color/outline_color use the ASS format &HAABBGGRR (not plain RGB). alignment: 2=bottom center, 8=top center.

extract_audio._comment: format can be: mp3, m4a/aac, or wav (lossless, larger file)
